{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the six QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Found {len(qa_orders)} QA orders with revenue 999999.99")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Found {len(refunded_orders)} refunded orders")

# Check for -1 in customer_age
missing_age = df[df['customer_age'] == -1]
print(f"Found {len(missing_age)} rows with customer_age = -1")

# Check revenue column type and example values
print("\nSample of revenue values:")
print(df['revenue'].head(10))"}
